title: Rippling launches controls that connect AI spending to business outcomes
friendlyTitle: Rippling adds a dashboard to control company AI costs
summary: Rippling launched AI Spend Console after its own token costs grew 80% month over month and headed toward 40% of its R&D payroll budget. The product maps vendor usage to teams and roles, links spend with measures such as pull requests and rework, and can route access through an AI gateway.
friendlySummary: Rippling built a tool that shows which teams and AI models cost the most. It can also compare that spending with work results and set rules for model access.
whyItMatters: AI costs can rise much faster than conventional software subscriptions, while raw token totals say little about value. Finance and technology leaders now need per-workflow cost, quality and outcome measures—not just broad adoption targets.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Businesses can use AI without letting the bill grow without control. The useful question is not only “How much AI did we use?” but also “Did it improve the work?”
